$schema: Arena's cube variants, in board-dropdown order. Loaded by bot/sets.py (Python) and frontend/src/data/cubeVariants.ts (JS). Edit here, both sides pick it up. 'expansion' is 17lands' name for the variant, kept verbatim on every draft event so the boards stay separable; the board code is CUBE-<slug>; 'glyph' is a 'keyrune:<glyph>' or 'mana:<glyph>' icon spec, the same form bot/scripts/upload_app_emojis.py takes; 'short' overrides the slug on a switcher chip, for a cube whose slug crowds the chip; 'seasoned' splits the variant's drafts into the season boards declared in 'seasons' instead of one flat board; 'opens' board sends a click on that cube to its own board instead of its newest season, for a cube that ran once; 'soup' false drops the Soup colour chip on that cube's board, for a cube multicolour enough that Soup swallows most of it.
$seasons: One entry per cube run WotC has scheduled, giving the board CUBE-<code>. Declared, never inferred: a run is announced in advance, so its dates are known and the boards must not move when someone drafts early or late. Dates are inclusive. 'code' names the board and nothing else: the powered cube runs alongside a set and carries its code, a planar cube week runs under no set and carries <SLUG>-<THEME>, which is why the boards never borrow a real set code they are not. 'label' names the run in the season picker, defaulting to '<CODE> Season', and 'glyph' gives it an icon where the code is not a set symbol. A run with no entry here gets no season board and its drafts still count on the variant's own board, so leaving one out loses a board and no data.
